note: rc.9 exists for one reason: the UI commit moved without its content changing. rc.8's pairing record named 01b0778a, the tip of the zeus-ui release branch; merging that branch squashed four commits into one and produced 62f75be7, so the UI release refused with 'Core record at v0.2.0-rc.8 names UI commit 01b0778a..., but this release is 62f75be7'. A squash merge rewrites the commit identity, which is exactly what the pairing contract treats as immutable. The tree is identical; only its hash is new. rc.9 is rc.8's code with the pairing record naming the commit that actually exists on zeus-ui's main. Nothing was published for the UI, and Core rc.8's packages stay as published — the release skips versions that already exist. firstPublish is empty: all 32 fixed packages have been published before.
stateNote: A state is recorded only when its evidence exists. null means "not reached", not "unknown". Partial publication records what actually published under the reached state and names the blocker; it is never rounded up to PAIR_ACCEPTED.
